missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Председатель' is a soft-stem masculine noun staying in the nominative as the subject of 'открыл'. 'Новый' is the agreeing masculine adjective.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative. 'Председателя' is animate masculine, so its accusative equals the genitive as the object of 'выбрали'. 'Нового' agrees in the animate accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Председателя' is genitive marking whose decision it is. 'Совета' is a further genitive showing the body he chairs.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Председателю' is dative after 'к', marking the person addressed.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Председателе' is prepositional after 'о', marking the topic of conversation.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Председателем' is instrumental after 'довольны', a short adjective that governs that case. 'Новым' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Председатели' is the nominative plural subject of 'собрались'.

Strategic focus: Animate accusative plural. 'Председателей' is animate, so the accusative plural equals the genitive plural as the object of 'пригласили'. 'Всех' agrees in the animate accusative plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Председателей' is genitive plural after 'много', counting an indefinite number.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject in a question. 'Председатель' is nominative as the predicate noun. 'Новый' agrees in the masculine nominative, and 'кто' asks the identity.
